# lucidity_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists every service account in the caller's Lucidity account. Works with a service account's own credentials too (reading is allowed).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lucidity_service_accounts" "all" {}

output "disabled_service_accounts" {
  value = [for sa in data.lucidity_service_accounts.all.service_accounts : sa.name if !sa.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Lucidity tenant ID (e.g. lucidity_tenant.<name>.tenant_id) to act on, sent as the X-tenant header. Overrides the provider's tenant_id; leave unset to use it. Needed when authenticating as a service account with roles on several tenants.

### Read-Only

- `service_accounts` (Attributes List) Every service account in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--service_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it can get new access tokens.
- `id` (String) Lucidity's ID for the service account.
- `name` (String) Name.
